verdict.rationale: Any organisation with a public website, including a law firm with online guides and self-serve tools, could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The probe found https://www.twobirds.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 404, and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation. The generator tools, Legora collaboration and GDPR guide are about other capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
